biochemical_description: 2-oxoglutarate is a key intermediate of the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle. 2-Oxoglutarate is produced from isocitrate and it is converted into succinyl-CoA. It also participates in the glutamate metabolism.

seasonal_trend: 2-Oxoglutarate did not differ significantly across seasons (p = 0.143).

seasonal_trend: 3-hydroxybutyrate concentrations were significantly influenced by season (p = 0.003), with the highest concentrations observed in winter and lower concentrations detected during spring, summer, and autumn.
